faqs.question: What is custom CRM development?
faqs.answer: Custom CRM development is the process of building tailored Customer Relationship Management software specifically designed for your company's workflows, data requirements, and customer lifecycle. Unlike generic off-the-shelf tools, a custom CRM gives you full ownership, zero per-user monthly subscription fees, and complete flexibility to integrate with your existing software stack.

faqs.question: Why should I choose a custom CRM over Salesforce or HubSpot?
faqs.answer: Off-the-shelf platforms like Salesforce and HubSpot often carry steep monthly per-seat costs, complex interfaces filled with unused features, and restrictive customization limits. A custom CRM gives your team an interface built specifically for your daily tasks, complete data privacy and ownership, seamless integration with custom APIs and intake forms, and lower long-term total cost of ownership (TCO).

faqs.question: Can you build customer intake forms and automated quoting portals?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in developing interactive customer intake portals (such as moving logistics intake forms, service booking portals, and consultation funnels). These systems capture user details step-by-step, calculate instant dynamic quotes, store lead data securely in the CRM, and trigger automated confirmations via email and WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How long does it take to develop a custom CRM system?
faqs.answer: A core custom CRM MVP or specialized customer intake portal typically takes 4 to 8 weeks to design, develop, test, and deploy. Comprehensive enterprise CRM platforms with complex role hierarchies, automated billing, and multi-system integrations generally take 8 to 14 weeks. We work in agile bi-weekly sprints so you can test features continuously.

faqs.question: Can you integrate our CRM with WhatsApp, telephony, and payment gateways?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We routinely integrate CRMs with WhatsApp Business API for instant customer chats, VoIP services (Twilio, RingCentral) for click-to-call recording, payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal) for automatic invoicing, and accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero).

faqs.question: How do you protect customer data and ensure privacy compliance?
faqs.answer: We enforce bank-grade security protocols across all CRM applications, including AES-256 data encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication (MFA), IP whitelisting, and compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.
